company_name: Dalian Fuji Plastics Products Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor containers and wafer carriers that meet industry standards and are used by over 100 global customers.
summary: Dalian Fuji Plastics Products Co., Ltd. manufactures semiconductor containers and wafer carriers designed to minimize contamination and enhance dimensional stability. Their products, branded under 'Paragon', are made from highly pure materials and are engineered for long-term use in the semiconductor and liquid crystal industries.

regional_presence.China: The company has a significant presence in China, serving over 100 global customers.
